name: ioctl_pagemap_scan
synopsis: int ioctl(int pagemap_fd, PAGEMAP_SCAN, struct pm_scan_arg *arg);
description: This ioctl is used to get and optionally clear specific flags from page table entries. It operates on a range of memory and returns information with PAGE_SIZE granularity.

parameters.name: PAGEMAP_SCAN
parameters.description: The ioctl request code for pagemap scan operation

parameters.name: arg
parameters.description: Pointer to the structure containing scan arguments and output buffers

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: Invalid arguments, such as invalid size, flags, categories, or unaligned start address
Invalid argument pointer, invalid vec pointer, or invalid address range
